name: AZD7268
summary: AZD-7268 is a δ-opioid receptor agonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder but was never marketed. It is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: AZD-7268 is a δ-opioid receptor agonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder but was never marketed. The affinity (Ki) of AZD-7268 for the δ-opioid receptor was reported to be 2.7 nM and its selectivity for this receptor over the μ-opioid receptor was reported to be 2,000-fold.

uses.text: AZD-7268 is a δ-opioid receptor agonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder but was never marketed. Dose-limiting side effects of AZD-7268 in clinical trials included syncope (fainting), hypotension (low blood pressure), and dizziness. Its development was discontinued in 2010.
